notes.finding: The prompt incorrectly described table/filter/sort/graphs as all behind details.
notes.correction: The table and its exploration controls are intentionally visible; graphs and supporting details are collapsible. Collapsing the whole table is a suggestion, not restoration of a stated product requirement.

notes.finding: The original scorecard alleges tag sorting fails to disable priority/remaining tie-breaking.
notes.correction: Existing browser checks distinguish tag order from request priority and passed. Keep the reviewer verdict and original text unchanged; this alleged defect is not accepted as demonstrated.

notes.finding: The reviewer suggests telling users that one pass to the last image completes their work.
notes.correction: Do not promise completion while skipped images remain unresolved without persistent uncertain judgments or a completion acknowledgement. The reviewer itself conditions this wording on actual partial-coverage policy.

notes.finding: The independent observer is not visible in the dashboard.
notes.correction: The five-minute observer is separate operational evidence collection. The UI reads current counts every 30 seconds while visible; the observer does not determine UI freshness.

notes.finding: An old completed experiment retains its completed label.
notes.correction: Completion is a historical terminal result scoped to this experiment, not a current-running/global-idle claim. Observation age and fetch time remain useful clarity improvements.
